name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text:
Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window eliminates truncation losses, giving us a measurable 0.7%+ capability bump over our current 32K model. The trade-off is higher compute cost—72B parameters vs. our 3B baseline—but the jump in raw reasoning power outweighs the burn.

Reject Llama3.2-3B-Instruct: its 128K window is irrelevant when the model itself can’t leverage it for meaningful gains.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K window is untested in production—its 3B params model already showed truncation losses we mitigated with chunking. The 0.7% bump assumes perfect context utilization; real-world latency spikes from 72B’s compute cost could erase gains. Test a 405B parameter model with a 1M token window—if it delivers even 0.5% net gain after tuning, it’s the safer bet.
